question: Describe a time you had to learn a new domain quickly.
intendedUser: Professional in Track-B with early-career experience
description: Behavioural interview question for Track-B professionals.
purposeOfQuestion: Interviewer evaluates candidate's learning agility skills.
exampleAnswer: I was assigned to a healthcare project with no prior domain knowledge. Situation: I had 2 weeks to understand. I shadowed subject matter experts, read industry documentation, and created a glossary of terms. Result: I could facilitate requirements sessions independently within 3 weeks.
weakAnswerPitfalls: Vague or generic response without specific examples
Focusing on process without mentioning personal contribution
Failing to connect to the target role
evaluationCriteria: Clarity, learning agility, specific examples, measurable outcomes
followUpQuestions: How does this apply to the Track-B role?
Can you provide more specific examples?
What would you do differently next time?
